description:
Activate Everflowing Chalice by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Everflowing Chalice.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Voltaic Key.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and Everflowing Chalice.
Repeat.

uses.name: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment
Everflowing Chalice
uses.cardState: with two or more charge counters on it
